cohort: Women with pregnancy-associated PE during pregnancy or within 6 weeks postpartum from 2004 to 2016 at KK Women's and Children's Hospital (KKH) and Singapore General Hospital (SGH) in Singapore
finding: The cumulative incidence of pregnancy-associated PE in Singapore is low and comparable to the UK and US, with the majority of PE cases occurring during the first 2 weeks postpartum, and a four times higher incidence in cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The cumulative incidence of postpartum PE was four times more in caesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
